references.text: The same formulation about 'putting away the evil from your midst' is used regarding false prophets who are to be put to death
The witnesses' hands shall first be against the guilty person in stoning, then the hands of all the people
The same expression 'put away the evil from Israel' is used regarding one who does not obey the priest or the judge
The same formula about putting away the evil and that all Israel shall hear and fear, used regarding false witnesses
Stoning and the formulation 'put away the evil from your midst' are also used regarding adultery
Stoning as a method of punishment and removing the evil from the people
Cursing parents is punished with death; the blood shall be on the guilty one
Whoever curses their father or mother shall die
An example of public execution where all Israel hears about it and fears
Stephen was stoned, a parallel to the Old Testament method of punishment
